scope: Human review of same-compound support from two extracted MS2 spectra
claim_boundary: Does not assign R/S configuration and does not infer enantioselective enrichment

adjudication.critical_rows: P1 conflict, P2 interference/boundary, and P3 insufficient rows should receive two blinded reviews
adjudication.identity_disagreement: A separate adjudicator resolves different non-uncertain identity labels
adjudication.automatic_result_visibility: Prefer blinded labels before showing the automatic diagnostic status during calibration

storage_rule: Reviewer annotations are separate from generated manifests and are never deleted by the exporter
